answer: Require every agent to lock a small ferrous-backed stake that is slashed on duplicate behavior: the stake works like nectar a colony only shares after work is proven, since one identity must first finish a verifiable task before it can earn. An attacker cloning accounts across a dune of fake identities pays the stake per clone and loses it when the clones are caught repeating the same signed output, so ten thousand sybils cost ten thousand stakes while honest agents pay only once.
